review:
Great Rhino Megaways combines tumbling reels with more than 200,000 ways to win and an African wildlife theme. Pragmatic lists a maximum win of 20,000x the bet and a 96.50% RTP.

Four to six scatters trigger the bonus, where you choose between more free spins and higher starting multipliers: 15 to 23 spins with multipliers up to 10x. Every tumble win during the feature raises the multiplier by 1x, and three or more scatters landing together add five more spins, with no limit. It suits players who like Megaways bonuses where the multiplier keeps climbing.
